newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel gears up for military operation - Berri.
newsitem.headline: Israel gears up for military operation - Berri.

text.p: Lebanese Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri said in remarks published on Friday that Israel was going to prepare for a military operation threatening the Middle East peace process.
"I warn that Israel will pave the ground for a military adventure...that will lead to thwarting the whole peace process," Berri said in a speech.

"Lebanon and Syria are directly concerned with confronting any aggression. This dictates increasing the cooperation an coordination at all levels because any Israeli aggression will aim for a strategic blow...to drive a wedge in the two countries' relations," he said in remarks carried by the official National News Agency.

Berri heads the Syrian-backed Shi'ite Moslem Amal movement whose fighters take part in the guerrilla war against Israeli troops occupying a border zone in south Lebanon -- the last active Arab-Israeli frontline.

His remarks followed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's declaration on Thursday that Israel would have to increase its defence budget "until we reach the defence and security levels that I view as necessary both to attain peace and preserve it".
Regional tension has risen after Netanyahu's election in May on a platform rejecting the principle of trading occupied Arab land for peace -- the basis of stalled peace talks.
